name: fuuz-dev-console
description: Read a Fuuz screen's console as an execution log and the state it produced — as a Chrome DevTools panel, or from the CLI.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/extract-elements.mjs --check && node scripts/extract-functions.mjs --check
scripts.test:panel: npm run build && node test/panel.smoke.mjs && node test/hook.smoke.mjs && node test/nativeConsole.smoke.mjs && node test/locator.smoke.mjs && node test/domStructure.smoke.mjs && node test/fiber.smoke.mjs && node test/routing.smoke.mjs && node test/runtimeScrape.smoke.mjs && node test/reachability.smoke.mjs && node test/webmcp.smoke.mjs && node test/storeTap.smoke.mjs
scripts.test:mcp: npm run compile:node && node test/mcp.smoke.mjs && node test/bridge.smoke.mjs && node test/screenshot.smoke.mjs
